top_choice_rationale: Magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene is a theory-led discovery: the 2011 continuum model predicted flat bands at discrete twist angles and the 2018 experiments found correlated insulating and superconducting states there, since reproduced by many groups and extended across van der Waals moire platforms. The three-name allocation (Bistritzer, MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero) and a citation limited to flat bands and the existence of the states, silent on the pairing mechanism, is defensible, though priority questions and omitted co-authors remain. The optical lattice clock (P002) is a cleaner, fully mature two-name case and a clear second; no award ranks last.
